title: CobbleChat Continuity
description: Keeps CreatureChat memory persistent for Cobblemon Pokémon across recall and respawn.
body:
🧠 CobbleChat Continuity

CobbleChat Continuity is a lightweight compatibility mod that bridges Cobblemon and CreatureChat, ensuring your Pokémon retain their memory, personality, and relationships even after being recalled and sent back out.

⚠️ The Problem

In Cobblemon, Pokémon are despawned and respawned when recalled, which gives them a new entity UUID. CreatureChat stores all conversational memory using that UUID, causing Pokémon to forget everything each time they are sent out again.

✅ The Solution

CobbleChat Continuity links CreatureChat’s memory system to each Pokémon’s persistent internal UUID, allowing memory to follow the Pokémon instead of the temporary entity.

✨ Features
💬 Persistent conversations across recall
🧠 Retains learned facts and preferences
❤️ Preserves personality and relationships
🔁 Automatic memory reassignment on respawn
⚡ Lightweight and seamless—no config required
⚙️ How It Works

The mod detects when a Pokémon entity respawns and reassigns its previous CreatureChat memory to the new entity using the Pokémon’s stable identity. It also handles timing edge cases to ensure memory is correctly synced to the client.

📦 Requirements
Cobblemon
CreatureChat
NeoForge
📝 Notes
Does not modify either mod directly
Safely disables itself if dependencies are missing
Compatible with existing worlds
💡 Why use this?

Because your Pokémon shouldn’t forget who they are—or who you are—every time you put them away.
